sourceDescription: User-supplied reference images. The five flat icons are Dune Wiki (Fandom) files uploaded by Eshogun671 as 2500 by 2500 PNGs; the stored originals are the wiki's 1000 px WebP conversions. Read through the wiki API on 2026-11-05: no file page states a license (the wiki-wide footer says CC-BY-SA, which no page says applies to these images), and the uploader is not stated to be the maker. The sunburst buckle filename credits Matt Griffin; its original publication was not identified.

request.scope: The user requested the same cropped, recolorable emblem-vector treatment for these six references: "do these as well".

preparation: The five flat icons were re-traced on 2026-11-05: alpha (foreground) of the 1000 px reference, cropped to sourceCrop and padded by 4 px; 4x Lanczos resize of the anti-aliased alpha, then threshold at 50 percent, so edges are decided at 4x and no source-pixel staircase survives; Potrace (potracer port of Potrace 1.16), turdsize 16, alphamax 1, opttolerance 0.2; the bitmapMaster is that thresholded 4x mask. Dune Zone normalization and stamp. The shaded buckle was manually redrawn into clean contours in a 4x bitmap master before tracing, and uses Potrace and the Dune Zone normalization and authoring pipeline.
preview: The six-vector preview, including the simplified buckle redraw, was shown in chat before catalogue integration.

/vector/emblem/lynch-dune.svg.preparation: Foreground alpha isolated, lettering removed by crop, enlarged 4x with Lanczos before thresholding, then traced.

/vector/emblem/sunburst-buckle-matt-grif.preparation: The shaded Matt Griffin reference was redrawn as clean frame, ray and rivet contours in a 4x bitmap master, then traced with Potrace.
/vector/emblem/sunburst-buckle-matt-grif.interpretation: Clean contours replace the shaded pencil texture; the frame, half-sun, rays, dotted arch and clasps are retained.

/vector/emblem/villeneuve.svg.preparation: Foreground alpha isolated, lettering removed by crop, enlarged 4x with Lanczos before thresholding, then traced.
